basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the last date, the application fee or the selection process.

qualification.details: Age limit: The upper age limit is fixed at 50 years as on 1 July 2026. | Educational qualification: The notice prints "Minimum 50% Marks" with the qualification details and lists these options: | MCA/Master in Computer Science/Other Post Graduation Degree in Computer Science/IT from a recognized university BCA/B.Sc/B.Tech/BE in computer science/information technology or information science from a recognized university Graduation with PGDCA from a recognized University/Institution recognized by AICTE "A" Level Certificate from DOEACC/NIELT | Experience and skills listed for the post: | Teaching experience in a similar capacity in a government or semi-government school Experience of working in a residential school and networking Knowledge of computer hardware and networking Achievements in the field of ICT of self, or mentoring of students at State/National level competitions | Check the official notification for the full eligibility of this post, including whether the experience and skills above are required or preferred.

how_to_apply: Use the specimen application form on page 2 of the notice, headed for selection of Computer Teacher (TGT) guest faculty.
Enter your name, date of birth, father's or guardian's name, mobile and WhatsApp numbers, email, permanent address and correspondence address.
Fill in the education table: examination passed, diploma or degree, university or institution, year of passing, total marks, marks obtained and percentage.
Fill in the experience table for government or semi-government institutions only: institution, type, place, designation, from and to dates, and total years or months.
Date the form and sign the declaration with your name.

content_sections.heading: About Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya
content_sections.text: Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya is a school located at Village Pipli, Tehsil Bilari, District Moradabad. The notice prints its CBSE Affiliation No. as 2120174.

content_sections.heading: Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Computer Teacher Vacancy Details 2026
Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Computer Teacher Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: The upper age limit is fixed at 50 years as on 1 July 2026. Educational qualification: The notice prints "Minimum 50% Marks" with the qualification details and lists these options: MCA/Master in Computer Science/Other Post Graduation Degree in Computer Science/IT from a recognized university BCA/B.Sc/B.Tech/BE in computer science/information technology or information science from a recognized university Graduation with PGDCA from a recognized University/Institution recognized by AICTE "A" Level Certificate from DOEACC/NIELT Experience and skills listed for the post: Teaching experience in a similar capacity in a government or semi-government school Experience of working in a residential school and networking Knowledge of computer hardware and networking Achievements in the field of ICT of self, or mentoring of students at State/National level competitions Check the official notification for the full eligibility of this post, including whether the experience and skills above are required or preferred.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for ten months from the date of engagement or till the end of April of the year, whichever is less. Long vacations are excluded from the engagement. The amount is the one decided for guest faculty Computer Teacher.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Computer Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Use the specimen application form on page 2 of the notice, headed for selection of Computer Teacher (TGT) guest faculty. Enter your name, date of birth, father's or guardian's name, mobile and WhatsApp numbers, email, permanent address and correspondence address. Fill in the education table: examination passed, diploma or degree, university or institution, year of passing, total marks, marks obtained and percentage. Fill in the experience table for government or semi-government institutions only: institution, type, place, designation, from and to dates, and total years or months. Date the form and sign the declaration with your name.

faq.question: Q1. How many Computer Teacher posts are vacant at Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya, Pipli?
faq.answer: The notice lists 01 post of Computer Teacher (TGT) on a guest faculty basis.

faq.question: Q2. Can a BCA graduate apply?
faq.answer: Yes. BCA is listed, along with B.Sc, B.Tech and BE, when the subject is computer science, information technology or information science from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is an "A" Level Certificate accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. An "A" Level Certificate from DOEACC/NIELT is one of the listed options.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: It runs for ten months from the date of engagement or till the end of April of the year, whichever is less, excluding long vacations.

faq.question: Q5. Which experience should go in the application form?
faq.answer: The form's experience table is for government and semi-government institutions only.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if wrong information is given in the form?
faq.answer: Under the declaration, the applicant accepts that the application may be cancelled if the information is later found to be false.
